name: uac-toggles-off-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): switches UAC all the way off -- EnableLUA=0 AND ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin=0 (elevate without prompting) AND PromptOnSecureDesktop=0 (consent dialog on the ordinary desktop). The hardened state is EnableLUA=1, the prompt value gone-or-nonzero, and PromptOnSecureDesktop=1-or-gone. Note EnableLUA=0 alone is not the full finding: the two prompt values ship ON by default and must be planted explicitly for the UAC checks to have a zero state. Vars: none. Pairs with a registry_value check on EnableLUA and powershell_json checks on ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin/PromptOnSecureDesktop. Idempotent.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableLUA -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -Value 0 -Type DWord
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PromptOnSecureDesktop -Value 0 -Type DWord
Write-Output 'UAC toggles off'
